browser: Microsoft Edge / Chromium, real DOM and hit-tested mouse
deviceBoundary: Real Edge rendered DOM and hit-tested pointer coordinates; no physical iPad/Safari, software keyboard, microphone, audible playback, wake word or long-running-device evidence.
assistantBoundary: Local instruction demonstration; a separately labelled loopback mock provider verifies outbound privacy. Neither is a real external LLM run.
fixtureBoundary: Fixed/accelerated clock; synthetic avatar with tagged metadata; isolated real HTTP servers and real model state. Stage gallery uses controlled starting ledgers, never claims user-earned points.
